  s=x.as_posix()
  return '/'+s[0].lower()+s[2:] if len(s)>1 and s[1]==':' else s
 env=os.environ.copy();env['FORGEWRIGHT_RLG_GATE']=bashpath(gate);env['FORGEWRIGHT_RLG_SWEEP']=bashpath(sweep)
 common=[shutil.which('bash'),(root/'scripts/runtime/runtime-hooks-install.sh').as_posix(),'--platform','agy','--agy-hooks',registry.as_posix()]
 rows=[]
 for action in ['--install','--verify']:
  r=subprocess.run(common+[action],cwd=root,env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,encoding='utf-8',errors='replace',timeout=15)
  rows.append({'action':action,'exit_code':r.returncode,'stdout':r.stdout,'stderr':r.stderr})
 data=json.loads(registry.read_text())
 print(json.dumps({'probe':'standalone-agy-installer-existing-gate-files','gate_file_exists':gate.is_file(),'sweep_file_exists':sweep.is_file(),'results':rows,'has_stop':any('Stop' in v for v in data.values() if isinstance(v,dict)),'registry':data}))

 html=base/('rf01-live-'+arm+'-workspace')/'drawer-motion.html'
